meta.name: Nabaperks customer flow frontend
meta.description: Consolidated frontend source for the customer QR journey (/q, /m, /card, /reward, terms) and logged-in wallet (/wallet). Includes dev harness UI. Excludes server actions, lib/customer data layer, and tests.
meta.stack: Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Wet Ink design system
notes: Server actions referenced by client forms live outside this bundle: app/m/[merchantSlug]/join/actions.ts, app/card/[membershipId]/actions.ts, app/reward/[rewardId]/actions.ts, app/wallet/actions.ts, app/dev/customer-flow/actions.ts
app/globals.css is the full app Wet Ink stylesheet (not customer-scoped)
